description: This file defines data structures and functions for managing network policies in Windows HNS, including route policies, load balancer policies, and policy list management functions.

classes.name: RoutePolicy
classes.description: Schema for route-based network policy including destination prefix, next hop, and encapsulation flag.

classes.name: ELBPolicy
classes.description: Schema for Elastic Load Balancer policies including VIPs, ILB, and DSR flags.

classes.name: LBPolicy
classes.description: Schema for load balancing policies including protocol and ports.

classes.name: PolicyList
classes.description: Schema representing a list of policies with associated endpoint references.

methods.name: HNSPolicyListRequest
methods.description: Performs a network policy list request to HNS with specified method, path, and request body.

methods.name: HNSListPolicyListRequest
methods.description: Retrieves all policy lists from HNS.

methods.name: PolicyListRequest
methods.description: Performs a network policy list request with specified method, path, and request body.

methods.name: GetPolicyListByID
methods.description: Retrieves a specific policy list by its ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new policy list in HNS.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the policy list from HNS.

methods.name: AddEndpoint
methods.description: Adds an endpoint to the policy list.

methods.name: RemoveEndpoint
methods.description: Removes an endpoint from the policy list.

methods.name: AddLoadBalancer
methods.description: Creates a load balancer policy list for specified endpoints.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Creates a route policy list for specified endpoints.
